summary_md: **Jerome Etienne #AI ([@jerome_etienne](https://x.com/jerome_etienne/status/2115415926866649092))** shipped **Heidrun Code v0.3.5**, an open-source app for managing multiple AI coding agents, adding chat timelines, better code navigation, voice input and notifications.
relevance: Another multi-agent coding cockpit, useful for comparing orchestration UX.
